How do I start a return or an exchange?
No worries, starting a return is pretty straightforward.
Timeframe: You can return items within 30 days of delivery, as long as they’re unused and in saleable condition. Engraved products can’t be returned.
UK returns: Use the online returns portal, search for “Chillys”, enter your details, and choose your preferred return method.
Outside the UK: Post the item to our returns address shown on your dispatch note (Asendia UK Ltd, Unit 2B Viking Industrial Estate, Hudson Road, Bedford, MK41 0QB, United Kingdom). We strongly recommend a tracked or signed-for service.
Bundles: You can’t return just part of a bundle – the full bundle, with all items intact and unused, has to be sent back.
Postage costs: We don’t offer free returns, so return postage is paid by you.
Damaged or faulty items: Please don’t send these back via the returns process. Instead, keep the item and contact our Customer Service team via the support widget so we can help without you paying return postage.
We currently only process refunds, not like-for-like exchanges, so to “exchange” an item you’d return it for a refund (if eligible) and place a new order for the product you’d like instead.
